source_snapshot.procedure: In BMC WebUI Configure, change a random BIOS setting to non-default, select Reboot Host Immediately, save/reboot, boot OS to load it, reboot again and verify in BIOS Setup.
source_snapshot.criteria: The changed setting persists after OS load and BIOS re-entry.
source_snapshot.script: No Master command; 15 attended/5 machine minutes; unique row/code/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; follows direct edit/reboot/persistence but calls it import despite no file and only asks for exact setting/dedicated SUT.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CRITICAL; identifies title-versus-body conflict, rejects random setting and requires reversible delta, backup, artifact/diff, two boot gates and restore.

old_problem: The title requires a BIOS configuration-file import while the Procedure only directly edits a random setting. Following either alone loses the other's coverage, and random BIOS changes plus two reboots can strand the SUT.
disposition_reason: ED-11/19/20/24 prohibit random/all BIOS mutation and coverage deletion. Both source surfaces can be retained safely as separate subtests under the same row/variant: A validates actual schema/file import of one approved reversible delta; B validates direct BMC Configure edit of that same approved setting. Each independently preserves the immediate reboot, OS Ready/load, second reboot, BIOS Setup persistence and restore sequence. Exact setting/artifact/schema are runtime project inputs, so the review can resolve without choosing or silently dropping either path.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2222, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2223 / Wistron-BMC Sanity-00006-V002 / 24e27f82a7675ec4 was directly read from XLSX and its historical record.

Never select a random/all BIOS option; bind one low-risk reversible dependency-free setting outside security, boot-device, memory-training, power and remote-access-critical domains unless explicitly required.
Export and hash the complete baseline; define current/default/target/restore values and check hidden dependencies before either subtest.
Subtest A must use a schema-valid minimal configuration artifact containing only the signed delta, with filename/version/hash, upload validation and exact staged diff.
Subtest B must use the explicit BMC Configure direct-edit surface and record the exact staged single-setting diff; it does not count as import evidence.

For each subtest separately: drain workloads, authorize Reboot Host Immediately, prove first OS Ready/load, authorize second reboot, verify target value in real BIOS Setup/KVM and no unrelated delta, then restore and verify baseline.
Stop on unexpected diff, apply failure, boot timeout/loop, lost BMC/KVM, dependency conflict or hardware error; never reapply/reboot automatically.
No WebUI/login/export/import/edit, BIOS change, reboot, KVM/Setup action, restore, retry, recovery or DUT action was executed.

test_case.test_name: Separate minimal BIOS configuration import and direct-edit persistence through two reboot gates
test_case.purpose: Validate both the BMC BIOS config-file import path and the direct Configure edit path with one approved reversible setting, proving each minimal delta persists through immediate reboot, OS load/Ready and a second reboot into BIOS Setup without unrelated changes, then restoring baseline.
required_package: SUT/BMC/BIOS/OS identities and full configuration export/hash
One approved reversible setting path with current/default/target/restore values and dependency analysis
Subtest A minimal schema-valid import file version/hash and expected single-delta diff
Subtest B exact direct-edit UI path and expected single-delta staged diff
Per-subtest workload drain, two reboot/readiness gates, KVM/console/CMOS recovery and final restore
test_case.test_command: Run A and B as separately authorized subtests, restoring baseline between them. A: upload the signed minimal one-delta config file, validate schema and exact diff, apply with Reboot Host Immediately, prove OS Ready/load, perform the second approved reboot, enter BIOS Setup and verify persistence/no unrelated delta, then restore. B: stage the same approved delta by direct BMC Configure edit, repeat the exact two readiness/reboot checks and BIOS proof, then restore. Preserve complete job, boot, KVM and config evidence; never retry automatically.
test_case.expected_result: For each path independently, exactly the approved setting changes to target, apply succeeds, first reboot reaches OS Ready/load, second reboot reaches BIOS Setup, the target persists, no unrelated value changes, and restoration returns the full configuration to baseline without BMC/host error.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires separate complete A-import and B-direct-edit evidence unless an explicit approved scope records one as not applicable without deleting it. Schema/upload/diff/apply failure, unexpected setting change, boot timeout/loop, missing persistence, unrelated delta, lost console or failed restore is FAIL for that subtest. Direct edit cannot PASS import and import cannot PASS direct edit. Missing artifact/setting/recovery blocks execution, not review.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until exact setting, baseline/restore, minimal import artifact, direct-edit path, staged diffs, workload drain, two-boot plan and console/CMOS recovery are signed.
No random/all setting; avoid security, boot, memory-training, power or remote-access-critical options unless separately authorized.
Review the exact single-delta diff before each apply and verify OS Ready before the next reboot.
Stop on unexpected diff, apply failure, boot timeout/loop, lost BMC/KVM, dependency or hardware fault; no automatic reapply/reboot.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and SUT/BMC/BIOS/OS identity plus full baseline export/hash
Approved setting current/default/target/restore and dependency/safety analysis
Subtest A import file schema/version/hash, upload validation, exact diff and job result
Subtest B direct-edit UI path, exact staged diff and apply result
Per-subtest immediate reboot, OS Ready/load, second reboot and real BIOS Setup persistence proof
No unrelated delta, baseline restore, BMC/SEL/host logs, recovery and separate subtest verdicts
test_case.recovery: On any diff, apply, boot, dependency or console anomaly, stop the current subtest and preserve evidence; do not reapply or reboot again automatically. Use KVM/console and the signed configuration backup or CMOS/vendor recovery to restore baseline and verify BMC/OS health before considering the other subtest.

source_conflict.reason: Title/import and body/direct-edit coverage are reconciled as separate required subtests with independent evidence and restoration. Neither substitutes for the other, and the prohibited random choice is replaced by one signed reversible delta.

blocked.reason: Both workflows and their persistence method are safely defined; exact setting/artifact/schema and recovery are runtime project configuration.
